overview: The Caravan Exchange Platform is Shar Vahl’s central hub for caravan arrivals, departures, and trade inspection.
history: The platform was built to formalize caravan access to Shar Vahl.
Clan trade posts were added to support regional commerce.
Cargo ramps were reinforced to handle heavy packbeasts.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the platform was expanded with new inspection alcoves.
Royal Guard checkpoints were installed to monitor caravan security.
hooks: A caravan arrives with rare goods from Grimling Forest.
A cargo ramp destabilizes during unloading.
A packbeast breaks free, causing a heroic event.
A caravan broker disputes a clan tariff.
